recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, pecorino, and parmesan cheese.
Cook the pancetta in a large pan until crispy.
Drain the spaghetti and reserve some pasta water.
Toss the spaghetti with the pancetta, then remove from heat and mix in the egg mixture.
Add reserved pasta water to adjust the sauce consistency.
Season with black pepper and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken Carbonara
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook linguine al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water before straining.
Combine eggs, Parmesan cheese, a pinch of salt, and pepper, and optional cream in a medium-sized bowl (image 2a). Whisk thoroughly and set aside (image 2b).

Meanwhile, cook bacon in a large stainless pan or cast iron skillet on medium heat until fully cooked, remove from the skillet, and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain. Keep 1-2 tablespoons of bacon grease in the skillet and discard the rest.

Add sliced chicken. Season with salt and pepper and cook until chicken is fully cooked through (about 5-7 minutes). The bacon fat should brown the chicken. In the last 1-2 minutes, add garlic and a pinch of olive oil. Cook until fragrant.

Turn the heat down to low and let the pan cool for 2-3 minutes. Remove from the heat if necessary. (If the pan is too hot, you’ll run the risk of scrambling the eggs.) Return the bacon to the pan and add the warm linguine. Add the egg mixture to the pan along with 1/4 cup of pasta water (image 5a). Toss with the pasta until fully mixed and creamy. Add more pasta water if the sauce feels too thick (image 5b).
Top with fresh basil and serve immediately with extra Parmesan cheese and garnish with fresh basil.

recipes.name: Chicken biryani
ingredients: A blend of whole spices like cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, cumin seeds, turmeric, garam masala
fresh herbs like cilantro and mint
other additions might include green chilies, fried onions, and bay leaves
instructions: Make the marinade by mixing yogurt, ginger, garlic, turmeric, red chili powder, garam masala, salt, mint leaves, and lemon juice.
Add chicken and coat evenly with the marinade. Keep in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. You can marinate the chicken overnight too.
While the chicken is marinating, rinse and drain the rice 2 to 3 times, then soak in water for 20 minutes.
While the rice is soaking, add ghee to a heavy-bottomed pan and add onions.

On medium heat, fry the onions stirring frequently until they start to turn golden brown - about 15 to 20 minutes. Remove the fried onions from the pan, leaving the excess ghee behind as we will use this pan to cook the chicken.
In a medium pot add 8 cups of water. Add cumin seeds, bay leaves, star anise, cardamom, cloves, and salt to the rice and bring the to a boil on high heat.

Drain the soaked rice and add it to the boiling water. Bring the rice to a full boil on high heat. Lower the heat to medium and cook uncovered for 5 to 6 minutes or until the rice is about 90% cooked. Drain the rice promptly and reserve.
To the pan with the remaining ghee, add the marinated chicken. Cook on medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning halfway through.Then, gently layer the partially cooked rice over the chicken

Top with caramelized onions and saffron-infused milk.Cover the pot and seal it with aluminum foil, then place some weight on top of the lid. Cook on low heat for 20 minutes, this is the steam or Dum cooking step. Turn the heat off and wait another 10 minutes before opening the pot.In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, pecorino, and parmesan cheese.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma
instructions: Combine the marinade ingredients in a large ziplock bag. Add the chicken, seal, the massage from the outside with your hands to make sure each piece is coated. Marinate 24 hours (minimum 3 hours).
Combine the Yogurt Sauce ingredients in a bowl and mix. Cover and put in the fridge until required (it will last for 3 days in the fridge).
Heat a large non-stick skillet with 1 tablespoon over medium high heat, or lightly brush a BBQ hotplate/grills with oil and heat to medium high.
Place chicken in the skillet or on the grill and cook the first side for 4 to 5 minutes until nicely charred. Turn and cook the other side for 3 to 4 minutes (the 2nd side takes less time).
Remove chicken from the grill and cover loosely with foil. Set aside to rest for 5 minutes.
Slice chicken and pile onto platter alongside flatbreads, Salad and the Yoghurt Sauce.
To make a wrap, get a piece of flatbread and smear with Yoghurt Sauce. Top with a bit of lettuce and tomato and Chicken Shawarma. Roll up and enjoy!.

recipes.name: Veg Pizza
ingredients: vegetables(Bell peppers, Broccoli, Cauliflower, Carrots, Mushrooms, Onions, Olives, Paneer, Pineapple, and Tomatoes)
Other ingredients(garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, and basil)
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over warm water in a small bowl. The water should be no more than 100 degrees F (40 degrees C). Let stand for 5 minutes until yeast softens and begins to form a creamy foam.

Sift flour, sugar, 1 tablespoon oregano, and 1 teaspoon salt into a large bowl. Mix egg and oil into dry ingredients; stir in yeast mixture. When dough has pulled together, turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 8 minutes. Lightly oil a large bowl, then place dough in bowl and turn to coat with oil. Cover with a light cloth and let rise in a warm place (80 to 95 degrees F (27 to 35 degrees C)) until doubled in volume, about 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 450 degrees F (235 degrees C). Lightly grease a baking sheet.

Cook and stir diced tomatoes, tomato paste, onion, 1 tablespoon oregano, garlic, onion powder, 1 teaspoon salt, and pepper in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook until sauce has thickened, 15 to 20 minutes.

Punch down dough and turn it out onto a lightly floured surface. Use a knife to divide dough into two equal pieces--do not tear. Shape dough into rounds and let rest for 10 minutes. Form dough into rectangles, and place onto prepared baking sheet. Spoon tomato sauce over dough. Sprinkle with 1 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese; top with bell pepper, onion, and mushroom. Sprinkle 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese over top.
Bake in preheated oven until crust is browned and crisp and cheese has melted, 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Lollipop
ingredients: Ginger-garlic paste or minced ginger and garlic
Red chili powder, red chili sauce, or red chili paste
Green chili peppers or spring onions
instructions: Whisk together the sauce ingredients in a bowl
Coat the chicken with the sauce or spice mix and flour or cornstarch
Heat oil in a pan or skillet for deep frying
Drop the coated chicken into the hot oil in batches
Fry until the chicken is crispy and golden brown
Remove from oil and place on a plate

recipes.name: Chocolate chip cookies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a bowl, cream together softened butter, brown sugar, and white sugar.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
Combine flour, baking soda, and salt. Gradually add to the wet ingredients.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until edges are golden brown.
Allow cookies to cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Gobi Manchurian
ingredients: Other ingredients(vegetable stock, ketchup, chile-garlic sauce, and green onion)
instructions: Clean the cauliflower and cut into small florets.Parboil or blanch by keeping it immersed in boiling hot water with salt for 15-20 minutes.
Make a batter with corn flour, all purpose flour and cooking soda if adding, thick enough to coat the cauliflowers.
You can either dip the well drained florets one by one in the batter or just mix all of it with the drained florets and deep fry.
Just make sure there is enough batter to coat the florets. Deep fry until crisp and light. Keep aside.
In a wide pan, add 3 tablespoon oil and add chopped garlic, chilli if adding.
Give a quick stir and then add finely chopped white part of the spring onion and the chopped onion and fry till transparent. I added colored capsicum too, just 2 tablespoon each.
Add both sauces, salt a little bit, sugar if adding, pepper and mix well.
Add the deep fried cauliflower florets and toss well to mix it evenly. Lastly add finely chopped green part of the spring onion and mix well for a minute.
Mix corn flour, vinegar in water.Add to the cauliflower, mix in high flame. Once you see a glaze and becomes shiny, switch off flame.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
instructions: Marinate chicken thighs in a mixture of yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, and Kashmiri red chili powder.
In a pan, melt butter and sauté the marinated chicken until browned.
Add tomato puree and cook until the oil separates. Stir in heavy cream.
Sprinkle kasuri methi, sugar, and salt. Simmer until the chicken is fully cooked.
Serve this creamy butter chicken over rice or with naan for an authentic Pakistani/Indian experience.

recipes.name: Mango Lassi
instructions: In a blender, combine diced mango, yogurt, milk, honey, and cardamom powder.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Add ice cubes and blend again until the lassi is chilled.
Pour into glasses and garnish with a sprinkle of cardamom.
Enjoy this refreshing Mango Lassi!

recipes.name: Blueberry Banana Smoothie
instructions: In a blender, combine blueberries, banana, Greek yogurt, almond milk, and honey.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Add chia seeds for extra nutrition and blend briefly.
Pour into a glass and enjoy this nutritious Blueberry Banana Smoothie!

recipes.name: South Indian Masala Dosa
ingredients: Dosa batter (fermented rice and urad dal batter)
instructions: In a pan, heat ghee and add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, and curry leaves.
Add chopped onions, green chilies, and turmeric powder. Sauté until onions are golden brown.
Mix in boiled and mashed potatoes. Cook until well combined and seasoned.
Spread dosa batter on a hot griddle to make thin pancakes.
Place a spoonful of the potato mixture in the center, fold, and serve hot.
Pair with coconut chutney for a delicious South Indian meal.

recipes.name: Pav Bhaji
ingredients: Vegetables(potatoes, peas, tomatoes, cauliflower, cabbage, carrots, or beans)
Spices(red chili powder, turmeric powder, cumin-coriander powder)
instructions: Boil the vegetables
Mash the vegetables
Heat oil and butter in a pan
Add chopped onion and ginger-garlic paste
Add chopped capsicum and tomato
Add spices
Add water
Add mashed vegetables and lemon juice
Serve with pav

recipes.name: Gobi Fries Rice
ingredients: Vegetables(Carrots, onions, beans, cabbage, capsicum, and peas are common additions)
Seasonings(Chili powder, garam masala, coriander powder, ginger garlic paste, soy sauce, red chili sauce, and pepper)
Other ingredients(Corn flour, maida, lemon juice, curd, and coriander leaves)
instructions: Mix all the ingredients to coat Cauliflower into a thick paste.
Put the Cauliflower pieces in the mixture and let the florets be coated well.

Put the coated pieces in boiling Oil and fry until they turn golden brown on a medium flame. When they turn golden, turn the flame to high and fry until they are crisp. (Check the tips on how to fry them to perfection).
Heat Oil and add Red Chillies, Curry Leaves and Garlic and fry.
Add chopped Onions, Green Chillies and fry until the Onions are cooked.
Add the Onions and the rest of the ingredients in the Rice and toss on a high flame.
Before you take it off the fire, add the fried Cauliflower florets and toss on a high flame.
Garnish with Green Coriander and serve hot.

recipes.name: Dry Fruit Laddu
instructions: Firstly, in a pan heat 1 tsp ghee. roast 1 cup badam, ½ cup cashew and ¼ cup pistachios.
Roast until the nuts turn crunchy. Keep aside.
In the same pan heat 1 tsp ghee, add ½ cup raisins and 6 anjeer.
Dry roast 3 tbsp pumpkin seeds, 3 tbsp sunflower seeds, 2 tbsp sesame, 1 tbsp poppy seeds, and 1 cup dry coconut.
Roast until the seeds turn crunchy. Keep aside.
Mix all the roasted nuts and seeds well. Keep aside.
In a large kadai heat 2 tbsp ghee. add 350 grams dates and cook on low flame.
After 5 minutes, the dates turn soft and mushy. Mash the dates until it turns paste texture.
Now add in roasted nuts and mix well.
Mix until everything is well combined.
Cool slightly, and start shaping into ladoo.
Finally, Dry Fruits Ladoo is ready to enjoy for up to a month.

recipes.name: Mothichor Laddu
ingredients: Nuts like pistachios or chopped nuts
instructions: Mix the ingredients together.
Fry the gram flour batter into small balls called boondis.
Boil sugar and water with a little lemon juice to prevent crystallization.
Add food coloring and mix.
Combine the boondis with the sugar syrup.
Cool and shape into ladoos.

recipes.name: Chicken Kebab
ingredients: Lemon Juice. Or apple cider vinegar.
Bell Peppers. Or other veggies of choice.
instructions: Place the chicken pieces in a large bowl and add the olive oil, garlic, soy sauce, oregano, green and red bell peppers, and lemon juice (or lemon zest). Mix everything well. Cover, and refrigerate for between 2 to 24 hours to let it marinate.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat. Arrange the chicken and peppers onto the skewers and lay them on a baking sheet to take out to the hot grill.
Oil the grill grates. Cook for about 7 minutes on each side, until the chicken is well done.

recipes.name: Mutton soup
instructions: Cut and wash the mutton pieces and take in pressure cooker.
Add two cups of water to it.
Add ginger garlic paste, salt, pepper powder, cumin powder and garam masala to it.
Mix together and close the pan.
Pressure cook for 5-6 whistles.
Once it cools down open the cooker, garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.
Mutton soup is ready.

recipes.name: Mango Icecream
ingredients: Cream(whipping cream, fresh cream, or thickened cream)
Milk powder, to improve texture and reduce ice crystals
Corn flour, to thicken the ice cream
instructions: Puree the mangoes until smooth.
Combine the mango puree with the cream and sweetener.
Whisk or beat until combined.
Freeze until set

recipes.name: Brownie
instructions: First, mix together the dry and wet ingredients in two separate bowls. Combine the sugar, flour, powdered sugar, cocoa powder, chocolate chips, and salt in a medium bowl. Then, whisk together the eggs, olive oil, and water in a large one.
Next, combine the wet and dry ingredients. Sprinkle the dry mixture over the wet one, and fold until just combined. The batter will be thick!.

Then, pour the batter into an 8×8 inch baking pan lined with parchment paper. Use a rubber spatula to spread it to all four sides of the pan and to smooth the top. The mixture will be very thick – that’s ok.

Finally, bake! Transfer the pan to a 325-degree oven and bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until a toothpick inserted comes out with a few crumbs attached. Allow the brownies to cool completely before slicing and serving. Enjoy!

recipes.name: Prawn curry
ingredients: 12-15 curry leaves fresh, not dried. If you can't get them fresh leave them out
1 Tbsp tomato paste with enough water to dilute to the consistency of pasatta
instructions: Make the spice mix.
Dilute the tomato paste with enough water to get to the consistency of passata.

Heat your frying pan (don't use non-stick) briefly over medium heat. Add the oil (you can use some of the oil from frying the shrimp). Use all the oil specified. It's important. You need that oil to bloom the spices. You don't want them to stick and potentially burn because you skimped on a bit of oil.
When the oil starts to shimmer add the cardamom and cinnamon stick. You should see little bubbles form around them. Let that go for around 20 seconds.
Now add the mustard and cumin seed along with the curry leaves. Stir and cook until the seeds start to crackle. This takes another 20 seconds or so.
Add the garlic ginger paste and large pieces of the two green chilies to the pan and cook, stirring constantly, until the paste stops sputtering.

Turn down the heat and add the spice mix. This is the moment of truth in any curry. Stir it constantly for 30 seconds. If it starts to darken lift the pan off the heat. You want the spice mix to cook in the oil but not burn. If it burns you are starting over. No way around it.
Turn the heat up to medium high. Add the diluted tomato paste immediately and stir until bubbles form (the oil will likely separate). This takes around 30 seconds to one minute depending on the heat.

Add 3 oz of curry base. Stir until you see small craters forming, around 30-45 seconds. If it takes much longer that's a sign that you can turn the meat up a bit more. Watch the edges of the pan. The curry can stick here. That's not a problem. Just scrape it back into the pan.
Now add 6 oz of curry base and stir briefly. Let it cook until the craters form again. This takes 1-2 minutes.
Add the rest of the curry base and let cook until the craters form. Turn the heat down to low. Add the coconut milk and stir.
Mix in the remaining diced green chili. Simmer for about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes. Stir to combine. Add the prawns and cook until they are just warmed through.
Serve with rice and/or parathas or chapatis.

recipes.name: Apple pie
ingredients: apples (Granny Smith, Honeycrisp, or a mix), peeled, cored, and sliced
instructions: Peel, core, and slice apples into thin slices.
Toss apples with sugar, brown sugar, lemon juice, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, and cornstarch. Let sit for 10-15 minutes.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Roll out one dough disc on a lightly floured surface and place in a 9-inch pie pan.
Pour in the apple filling and dot with butter pieces.
Roll out the second dough disc and place it over the filling. Seal and crimp the edges. Cut small slits for ventilation.
Brush the top crust with an egg wash (1 egg beaten with a little water).

recipes.name: Grilled chicken salad
ingredients: salad greens,cherry tomatoes,cucumber (sliced),red onion (thinly sliced),cup shredded carrots,avocado (sliced)
instructions: In a bowl, mix olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice.
Coat the chicken breasts with the marinade and let them sit for 15-30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan over medium heat.
Grill the chicken for about 5-6 minutes per side until fully cooked (internal temperature of 165°F/75°C).
Remove from the grill and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
In a large bowl, combine salad greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, shredded carrots, avocado, feta cheese, and toasted nuts.

recipes.name: Chicken curry with rice
ingredients: 1 teaspoon red chili powder (adjust to taste)
½ cup yogurt (or coconut milk for a creamy texture)
instructions: Rinse the rice in cold water until the water runs clear.
In a pot, bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
Add rice, salt, and butter/ghee. Cover and cook on low heat for about 12-15 minutes until the rice is soft and fluffy.
Turn off the heat and let it sit for 5 minutes before fluffing with a fork.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften.
Mix in turmeric, red chili powder, cumin, coriander powder, and salt. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add chicken pieces and coat them in the spices. Cook for 5-7 minutes until they start browning.
Stir in yogurt (or coconut milk) and mix well.
Pour in water or broth, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Add garam masala, mix, and cook for another 2 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro.

recipes.name: Stuffed mushrooms
ingredients: ¼ teaspoon red pepper flakes (optional, for spice)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Clean the mushrooms with a damp cloth and remove the stems.
Finely chop the mushroom stems and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped mushroom stems and minced garlic, cooking until softened (about 3-4 minutes).
Remove from heat and mix in breadcrumbs, Parmesan cheese, cream cheese, parsley, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Stir well until combined.
Spoon the filling into each mushroom cap, pressing it down gently.
Drizzle melted butter over the stuffed mushrooms for extra flavor.
Arrange the stuffed mushrooms on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 18-20 minutes or until the tops are golden and the mushrooms are tender.
Let them cool for a couple of minutes before servin

recipes.name: Cheesecake
ingredients: ½ cup (120ml) sour cream or heavy cream
Fresh berries, chocolate drizzle, or caramel sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°F (163°C).
In a bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter until combined.
Press the mixture firmly into the bottom of a 9-inch (23cm) springform pan.
Bake for 8-10 minutes, then let it cool while preparing the filling.
In a large bowl, beat the softened cream cheese until smooth.
Add sugar and mix until creamy.
Beat in eggs, one at a time, mixing gently.
Stir in vanilla extract, sour cream (or heavy cream), and flour until combined.
Pour the cheesecake filling over the cooled crust.
Place the pan in a larger baking dish and fill it with hot water
Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until the center is slightly jiggly but set.
Turn off the oven, crack the door open, and let the cheesecake cool inside for 1 hour.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours (preferably overnight) for the best texture.

recipes.name: Spring rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour + 2 tablespoons water (for sealing)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add garlic and ginger, sauté for 30 seconds.
Add cabbage, carrots, bell peppers, and bean sprouts. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, black pepper, and salt. Mix well and cook for another minute.
Remove from heat and let the filling cool completely.
Place a spring roll wrapper on a flat surface in a diamond shape.
Add 1-2 tablespoons of filling near one edge.
Fold the bottom over the filling, then fold the sides inward.
Roll tightly and seal the edge with the flour-water paste.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F (175°C).
Fry the spring rolls in batches until golden brown and crispy (about 3-4 minutes).
Remove and drain on a paper towel.

recipes.name: Garlic bread
instructions: In a bowl, mix softened butter, minced garlic, parsley, salt, and black pepper.
Stir well until combined.
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Slice the baguette or Italian bread in half lengthwise.
Spread the garlic butter evenly over both halves.
Place the bread on a baking sheet, buttered side up.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until golden and crispy.
For extra crispiness, broil for 1-2 minutes at the end.

recipes.name: Stir-fried noodles
ingredients: 200g (7 oz) egg noodles, rice noodles, or ramen
1 cup mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, cabbage, broccoli)
½ cup protein (chicken, shrimp, tofu, or beef, optional)
1 tablespoon oyster sauce (or hoisin sauce for a vegetarian version)
½ teaspoon chili flakes (optional, for spice)
instructions: Boil water and cook the noodles according to package instructions (usually 2-3 minutes).
Drain, rinse with cold water, and toss with a little oil to prevent sticking.
Heat oil in a wok or large pan over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and onions, stir-fry for 30 seconds.
If using protein (chicken, tofu, shrimp), add it now and cook until done.
Add mixed vegetables and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until slightly tender.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan.
Pour in the sauce and mix well, stir-frying for 2 more minutes.
Finish with a drizzle of sesame oil for extra flavor.

recipes.name: Veggie wrap
ingredients: 2 large whole wheat or flour tortillas
½ cup hummus, cream cheese, or yogurt-based dressing
¼ cup cooked chickpeas or grilled tofu (optional for protein)
instructions: Wash and chop all vegetables into thin slices or bite-sized pieces.
If using chickpeas or tofu, season lightly with salt and pepper.
Lay a tortilla flat on a clean surface.
Spread a layer of hummus, cream cheese, or dressing on the tortilla.
Evenly distribute the lettuce, cucumber, bell peppers, onion, carrots, avocado, and cherry tomatoes.
Sprinkle feta cheese and chickpeas or tofu for extra flavor and protein.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla and roll tightly into a wrap.
Slice in half and serve fresh.

recipes.name: Lemonade
instructions: Juice the lemons and strain out the seeds.
In a small saucepan, dissolve the sugar in 1 cup of water over low heat to create a simple syrup.
In a pitcher, combine the lemon juice, simple syrup, and remaining water.
Stir well and add ice.
Garnish with fresh mint or lemon slices if desired.

recipes.name: Iced Coffee
instructions: Brew a strong cup of coffee and let it cool to room temperature. (For quicker cooling, place it in the fridge.)
Fill a glass with ice cubes.
Pour the cooled coffee over the ice.
Add sugar or sweetener if desired and stir well.
Top with milk, cream, or flavored syrup for extra taste.
Enjoy your refreshing iced coffee!

recipes.name: Ice Cream Sundae
ingredients: 2–3 scoops of ice cream (vanilla, chocolate, strawberry, or any flavor)
Chocolate syrup, caramel sauce, or strawberry sauce
instructions: Scoop ice cream into a serving bowl or a tall glass.
Drizzle your favorite syrup (chocolate, caramel, or strawberry) over the ice cream.
Add toppings like nuts, sprinkles, or crushed cookies.
Pipe or spoon whipped cream on top.
Garnish with a maraschino cherry.
Serve immediately and enjoy your delicious sundae!

recipes.name: Guacamole & Chips
instructions: Cut the avocados in half, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Mash the avocados with a fork to your preferred consistency (chunky or smooth).
Add diced tomato, chopped onion, jalapeño, and minced garlic.
Mix in lime juice, cilantro, salt, pepper, and cumin (if using).
Stir everything together and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve immediately or cover with plastic wrap (directly on the surface) to prevent browning.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Fry tortilla triangles in batches until golden and crispy (about 1–2 minutes per side).
Remove and drain on paper towels.
Sprinkle with salt while still warm.
Serve with fresh guacamole and enjoy!

recipes.name: Hummus with Pita Bread
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas (drained and rinsed) or 1½ cups cooked chickpeas
2 tbsp olive oil (plus extra for drizzling)
2 cups all-purpose flour (or whole wheat flour)
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, olive oil, cumin, and salt.
Blend until smooth, gradually adding cold water until you reach your desired consistency.
Transfer to a serving bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and garnish with paprika and chopped parsley.
In a bowl, mix flour, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Gradually add warm water and olive oil, mixing to form a dough.
Knead for about 5 minutes until smooth. Cover and let it rise for 1 hour.
Divide the dough into small balls and roll them into flat circles.
Cook on a hot skillet or bake at 450°F (230°C) for 5–7 minutes until puffed and golden.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast
ingredients: 2 slices of bread (whole grain, sourdough, or your choice)
instructions: Toast the Bread – Toast your bread slices until golden and crispy.
Prepare the Avocado – Cut the avocado in half, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Mash & Season – Mash the avocado with a fork, then mix in lemon juice, salt, pepper, and olive oil (if using).
Assemble the Toast – Spread the mashed avocado over the toasted bread.
Add Toppings – Customize with your favorite toppings, such as eggs, cheese, or veggies.
Serve & Enjoy – Eat immediately while fresh and crispy!

recipes.name: Smoothie Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup frozen mixed berries (strawberries, blueberries, raspberries)
½ cup Greek yogurt or plant-based yogurt
½ cup milk (almond, coconut, or regular)
1 tbsp chia seeds or flaxseeds (for extra nutrition)
instructions: Blend the Base – In a blender, combine frozen banana, berries, yogurt, milk, and sweetener. Blend until thick and smooth. If too thick, add a splash of milk.
Pour into a Bowl – Transfer the smoothie mixture to a bowl.
Add Toppings – Arrange fresh fruit, granola, nuts, and seeds on top.
Serve & Enjoy – Eat immediately with a spoon for a refreshing, nutrient-packed meal!

recipes.name: Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 2 cups milk (whole, almond, or oat milk)
¼ cup chopped dark or milk chocolate (for extra richness)
instructions: Heat the Milk – In a saucepan over medium heat, warm the milk until hot but not boiling.
Mix in Cocoa & Sugar – Whisk in cocoa powder, sugar, and salt until fully dissolved.
Add Chocolate & Vanilla – Stir in chopped chocolate and vanilla extract, whisking until smooth and creamy.
Serve Hot – Pour into a mug and top with whipped cream or marshmallows.
Enjoy! – Sip and savor the rich, chocolatey goodness.

recipes.name: Chicken Popcorn
ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (cut into bite-sized cubes)
½ tsp chili powder (optional, for spice)
1 tsp baking powder (helps with crisp texture)
instructions: Marinate the Chicken – In a bowl, mix chicken pieces with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, chili powder, and buttermilk. Let it marinate for 20–30 minutes.
Prepare the Coating – In a separate bowl, mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and spices.
Coat the Chicken – Dip each chicken piece into the flour mixture, then into the beaten egg, and back into the flour mixture for a crispy texture.
Heat the Oil – In a deep pan, heat oil to 350°F (175°C).
Fry Until Golden – Fry chicken pieces in batches for 3–4 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. Drain on paper towels.
Serve Hot – Enjoy with ketchup, garlic mayo, or spicy dip!

recipes.name: Vegetable Pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour (or whole wheat flour)
instructions: Prepare the Batter – In a bowl, whisk together flour, water, egg, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder until smooth.
Add Vegetables – Mix in the shredded and chopped vegetables until well combined.
Heat the Pan – In a skillet, heat oil over medium heat.
Cook the Pancakes – Pour a ladleful of batter into the pan, spreading it into a thin layer. Cook for 2–3 minutes on each side until golden brown and crispy.
Repeat – Continue with the remaining batter, adding more oil if needed.
Prepare Dipping Sauce – Mix soy sauce, vinegar, sesame seeds, honey, and chili flakes in a small bowl.
Serve Hot – Enjoy your crispy vegetable pancakes with the dipping sauce!

recipes.name: Greek Salad
ingredients: 4 oz feta cheese (cut into cubes or crumbled)
instructions: Prepare the Vegetables – Wash and chop tomatoes, cucumber, onion, and bell pepper.
Assemble the Salad – In a large bowl, combine all the vegetables and olives.
Make the Dressing – In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, pepper, and garlic (if using).
Add Feta & Dressing – Place feta cheese on top of the salad and drizzle with the dressing.
Toss & Serve – Gently mix and serve fresh!

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable or chicken broth (kept warm)
1 cup mushrooms (button, cremini, or shiitake, sliced)
½ cup dry white wine (optional, enhances flavor)
instructions: Sauté the Mushrooms – In a pan, heat 1 tbsp olive oil or butter and sauté the mushrooms until golden brown. Set aside.
Cook the Aromatics – In the same pan, add the remaining oil or butter and sauté the onion and garlic until soft.
Toast the Rice – Add Arborio rice and stir for 1–2 minutes until slightly translucent.
Deglaze with Wine (Optional) – Pour in white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add Broth Gradually – Add ½ cup of warm broth at a time, stirring frequently. Let the rice absorb the liquid before adding more. Repeat until the rice is creamy and tender (about 20 minutes).
Mix in Mushrooms & Cheese – Stir in the sautéed mushrooms and Parmesan cheese. Adjust seasoning with salt and black pepper.
Serve & Garnish – Sprinkle with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan. Serve warm!

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
ingredients: 1 tsp red chili powder (adjust to taste)
½ cup fresh cream (or heavy cream)
1 tbsp dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi, crushed)
instructions: Heat butter and oil in a pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add tomato puree and cook until the oil starts separating from the mixture (about 10 minutes).
Blend soaked cashews into a smooth paste and add it to the pan. Stir well.
Add turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala, and salt. Cook for another 5 minutes.
Pour in water and let the gravy simmer for 5 minutes.
Add cubed paneer to the gravy and mix gently. (Optional: Lightly fry paneer in butter before adding.)
Stir in fresh cream and crushed dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi). Cook for 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust salt or sweetness if needed.

recipes.name: Baked Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: ½ tsp cinnamon (optional, for a sweeter version)
instructions: Preheat Oven – Set the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Prepare the Sweet Potatoes – Wash and scrub the sweet potatoes. Pat dry.
Pierce with a Fork – Poke a few holes all over the potatoes with a fork to allow steam to escape.
Coat with Oil & Seasoning – Rub the potatoes with olive oil or butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake – Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 45–60 minutes, until fork-tender.
Serve Hot – Slice open, fluff with a fork, and add your favorite toppings!

recipes.name: French Fries
ingredients: 3 large russet potatoes (or any starchy potatoes)
½ tsp paprika (optional, for extra flavor)
instructions: Peel the potatoes (optional) and cut them into thin, even strips.
Soak the potato strips in cold water for 30 minutes to remove excess starch (makes them crispier).
Drain and pat dry completely with a kitchen towel.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 325°F (165°C).
Fry the potatoes in batches for 3–4 minutes, until slightly cooked but not browned.
Remove and place on a paper towel. Let them rest for 10–15 minutes.
Increase oil temperature to 375°F (190°C).
Fry the potatoes again for 3–5 minutes, until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and immediately sprinkle with salt and seasoning.

recipes.name: Onion Rings
ingredients: ½ tsp paprika (optional, for extra flavor)
1 cup cold sparkling water or milk (adds fluffiness)
1½ cups breadcrumbs or panko (for extra crunch)
instructions: Peel onions and cut into ½-inch thick rings. Separate the rings and set aside.
In a bowl, mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, pepper, and paprika.
Whisk in cold sparkling water or milk and the egg (if using) until smooth.
Dip each onion ring into the batter, ensuring full coverage.
Coat with breadcrumbs or panko for extra crunch.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F (175°C).
Fry onion rings in batches for 2–3 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and immediately sprinkle with a little extra salt.

recipes.name: Bhel Puri
instructions: Blend all green chutney ingredients into a smooth paste. Set aside.
Simmer tamarind chutney ingredients in a small pan for 5 minutes until thick. Let cool.
In a large bowl, mix puffed rice, chopped onions, tomatoes, cucumber, potatoes, and peanuts.
Add chaat masala, salt, red chili powder, and both chutneys (adjust spice and sweetness).
Mix well, ensuring everything is coated evenly.

recipes.name: Kheer
ingredients: ½ cup basmati rice (washed & soaked for 30 minutes)
¼ tsp saffron strands (optional, for color & aroma)
1 tsp rose water (optional, for extra fragrance)
instructions: Heat milk in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat until it starts to boil.
Drain the soaked rice and add it to the boiling milk.
Drain the soaked rice and add it to the boiling milk.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally to prevent burning.
Cook for 25-30 minutes until the rice becomes soft and the milk thickens.
Add sugar and mix well until dissolved.
Stir in cardamom, saffron, and chopped nuts (roast nuts in ghee for extra flavor if desired).
Let it simmer for another 5 minutes, stirring gently.
Turn off the heat and add rose water (if using).
Garnish with extra nuts and saffron strands.
Serve warm or chilled for the best taste!

recipes.name: Red Velvet Cake
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk (or 1 cup milk + 1 tbsp vinegar)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 8-inch cake pans.
In a bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, mix buttermilk, butter, oil, eggs, vanilla, vinegar, and red food coloring.
Gradually combine the dry ingredients with the wet ingredients, stirring until smooth.
Divide the batter evenly between the two cake pans.
Bake for 30–35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let the cakes cool completely before frosting.
Beat cream cheese and butter until smooth.
Add powdered sugar and vanilla extract, and mix until creamy.
Place one cake layer on a plate, spread frosting evenly, and stack the second layer on top.
Cover the entire cake with frosting and smooth it out.
Decorate with red velvet crumbs or sprinkles.

recipes.name: Black Forest Cake
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk (or 1 cup milk + 1 tbsp vinegar)
1 cup hot water or coffee (enhances chocolate flavor)
1 ½ cups canned or fresh cherries (pitted and chopped)
¼ cup Kirsch (cherry brandy) or cherry juice (for a non-alcoholic version)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 8-inch cake pans.
In a large bowl, sift together flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
Add eggs, buttermilk, oil, and vanilla extract. Mix well.
Stir in hot water or coffee, mixing until smooth.
Divide batter evenly between the two pans and bake for 30–35 minutes.
Let the cakes cool completely before assembling.
In a saucepan, heat cherries, sugar, and cornstarch over medium heat. Stir until the mixture thickens.
Add Kirsch or cherry juice and mix well. Let it cool.
Beat heavy cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract until stiff peaks form.
Slice the cakes into two layers each (optional for extra layers).
Place the first cake layer on a plate, brush with Kirsch or cherry juice.
Spread whipped cream and a layer of cherry filling.
Repeat with the remaining layers.
Cover the entire cake with whipped cream and smooth it out.
Sprinkle chocolate shavings over the top and sides.
Garnish with whole cherries on top.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving for the best flavor.

recipes.name: Oreo Cheesecake
ingredients: ½ cup sour cream (or Greek yogurt)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F (163°C).
Crush Oreo cookies into fine crumbs and mix with melted butter.
Press the mixture into a greased 9-inch springform pan.
Bake for 10 minutes, then let it cool.
In a bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth.
Add sugar, vanilla, and sour cream, mixing well.
Add eggs, one at a time, and mix until just combined.
Gently fold in chopped Oreos.
Pour the cheesecake batter over the crust.
Bake for 40–45 minutes, until the center is slightly jiggly but set.
Turn off the oven and let the cheesecake cool inside with the door slightly open.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours (preferably overnight).
Top with whipped cream, crushed Oreos, and chocolate syrup before serving.
Slice and enjoy your creamy Oreo cheesecake!

recipes.name: sushi
ingredients: ½ cup imitation crab, cooked shrimp, or fresh salmon/tuna
instructions: Rinse sushi rice under cold water until the water runs clear.
Cook rice in 2 ½ cups water (using a rice cooker or stovetop). Let it cool slightly.
In a small bowl, mix rice vinegar, sugar, and salt, then stir it into the cooked rice. Let it cool completely.
Place a nori sheet on a bamboo sushi mat (shiny side down).
Spread a thin layer of sushi rice evenly over the nori, leaving 1 inch at the top.
Add your chosen fillings in a line near the bottom of the rice.
Use the bamboo mat to tightly roll the sushi, applying gentle pressure.
Wet the top edge with water to seal the roll.
Use a sharp knife to cut the roll into 6–8 pieces (wipe the knife with a damp cloth between cuts).
Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.
